thread:
anya: proposing staged rollout for stream frame v2 (chunk+meta). Need product+eng+SRE alignment on flags, canary, per-tenant fallback.

sam: agree. risks = strict client parsers + streaming tail perf.

lee: rollout plan: blue-team (10 hosts) -> 3 opt-in enterprise tenants -> 5% public (X-Stream-Protocol:v2) -> gradual ramp with auto-cut.

maria: infra gates: per-tenant circuit-breaker, tenant kill-switch flag, 100% trace sampling for canaries.

sam: implement session-level fallback: on parser error rewrite v2->v1 for session.

devops-bot: deploy started: rollout/stream-v2-proxy -> staging.

sales-eng: collecting top customers SDK+parser notes, CSV by EOD.

maria: telemetry gates: parser_exception_rate, streaming_latency_p50/p95, incomplete_stream_count, proxy_fallback_rate. Alert if parser_exception_rate >0.1% for tenants >1M tokens/day.

anya: pre-5% checks: SDK compatibility doc, 48h canary clear, rollback + tenant-opt-out docs.

lee: add Console header X-Stream-Compat:v1 for manual opt-out.

maria: staging adds ~4ms p50; acceptable short-term, abort if p95>100ms.

customer-ops: private installs need runtime ENV flag in agent 0.9.3.

anya: decision for PL: proxy short-term OK? deprecate v1 in 9 months? flagged customers opt-in only.

lee: +1.

sam: eng estimate: 2 sprints for proxy hardening + QA/SRE.

maria: I'll draft runbook fragments and dashboards.

anya: actions: sam: proxy design+perf targets (3d); maria: dashboards/synthetics (5d); sales-eng: customer list (EOD); lee: confirm deprecation timeline.

devops-bot: deploy succeeded: rollout/stream-v2-proxy -> staging (build 2026.03.18.07).

maria: staging perf: p50 +3.8ms, p95 +9.2ms, no parser exceptions in 6h.

anya: move to opt-in invites tomorrow if green.
